note: Robinhood's hosted MCP (https://agent.robinhood.com/mcp/trading) uses per-user OAuth with no service-account or sandbox credential available in this local dev environment, so its tools/list cannot be called headlessly by a standalone script here. This snapshot was captured by listing tools inside an authenticated Claude Code session on the date above and is used as the deterministic classifier's input until an automated OAuth-capable fetch is wired up (see mcp/robinhood_inventory.py).

tools.name: get_accounts
tools.description: List the user's brokerage accounts. Use this to look up account_number values needed by other tools. Does NOT return reliable buying power — route buying-power questions through get_portfolio.

tools.name: get_earnings_calendar
tools.description: List earnings reports scheduled across the market over a date window (up to 31 days), optionally limited to high-market-cap names. Read-only.

tools.name: get_earnings_results
tools.description: Get recent and upcoming earnings for ONE equity symbol — estimated/actual EPS, report date/timing, verification status. Read-only.

tools.name: get_equity_fundamentals
tools.description: Get today's fundamentals for one or more stock symbols — valuation ratios, capitalization, OHLCV, 52-week range, dividends, company profile.

tools.name: get_equity_historicals
tools.description: Get OHLCV bars for one or more equity symbols across an explicit time range. For charting, backtesting.

tools.name: get_equity_orders
tools.description: Fetch equity orders for an account — list or single-order mode. Read-only order history/status lookup.

tools.name: get_equity_positions
tools.description: List open equity positions for a specific brokerage account.

tools.name: get_equity_quotes
tools.description: Get real-time stock quotes and the official last-completed-session close for one or more symbols.

tools.name: get_equity_tax_lots
tools.description: List the open tax lots for one equity holding in an account.

tools.name: get_equity_technical_indicators
tools.description: Compute a technical indicator (RSI, MACD, Bollinger Bands, moving averages, ATR, VWAP, etc.) over one equity symbol's OHLCV bars.

tools.name: get_equity_tradability
tools.description: Check tradability for up to 10 equity symbols on a given account: per-session eligibility and fractional support.

tools.name: get_index_quotes
tools.description: Get real-time values for one or more market indexes by instrument ID.

tools.name: get_indexes
tools.description: Get index data for market indexes by symbol.

tools.name: get_option_chains
tools.description: List option chains for one or more underlyings — expiration dates and contract set.

tools.name: get_option_historicals
tools.description: Get OHLC price bars for one or more option contracts across an explicit time range.

tools.name: get_option_instruments
tools.description: List option contracts filtered by chain/expiration/strike/type/state.

tools.name: get_option_orders
tools.description: Fetch options orders for an account — list or single-order mode. Read-only order history/status lookup.

tools.name: get_option_positions
tools.description: List options positions for an account, open and closed.

tools.name: get_option_quotes
tools.description: Get real-time quotes for one or more option contracts by instrument UUID.

tools.name: get_option_watchlist
tools.description: List the single-leg option contracts on the user's options watchlist.

tools.name: get_pnl_trade_history
tools.description: Get a customer's per-trade realized profit & loss — chronological list of closed/realizing trades. Read-only.

tools.name: get_popular_watchlists
tools.description: Discover Robinhood-curated lists the user can follow.

tools.name: get_portfolio
tools.description: Get the account's portfolio market value breakdown by asset type and buying power.

tools.name: get_realized_pnl
tools.description: Get a customer's realized profit & loss for an account over a time window — aggregate bucketed totals. Read-only.

tools.name: get_scans
tools.description: List the authenticated user's saved scanners (screeners). Takes no parameters.

tools.name: get_watchlist_items
tools.description: List the items in a watchlist (stocks/ETFs, crypto, futures, indexes).

tools.name: get_watchlists
tools.description: List the user's watchlists, including user-created and Robinhood-curated followed lists.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Resolve a natural-language query to Robinhood instruments (stocks/ETFs), crypto pairs, or market indexes.

tools.name: run_scan
tools.description: Execute a saved scanner and return live market results. Read-only (executes a saved filter, does not mutate account state).

tools.name: place_equity_order
tools.description: Place a real equity order with real money. WRITE / ORDER EXECUTION — prohibited for this research pipeline.

tools.name: place_option_order
tools.description: Place a real options order with real money. WRITE / ORDER EXECUTION — prohibited for this research pipeline.

tools.name: review_equity_order
tools.description: Simulate (preview) a stock order without placing it. WRITE-adjacent order-preview tool — prohibited for this research pipeline per the no-order-preview requirement.

tools.name: review_option_order
tools.description: Simulate (preview) an options order without placing it. WRITE-adjacent order-preview tool — prohibited for this research pipeline per the no-order-preview requirement.

tools.name: cancel_equity_order
tools.description: Cancel an open equity order by order_id. WRITE — prohibited.

tools.name: cancel_option_order
tools.description: Cancel an open option order by account_number + order_id. WRITE — prohibited.

tools.name: add_to_watchlist
tools.description: Add items to a watchlist. WRITE — prohibited (no Robinhood watchlist changes).

tools.name: remove_from_watchlist
tools.description: Remove items from a watchlist. WRITE — prohibited.

tools.name: add_option_to_watchlist
tools.description: Add option contracts to the user's options watchlist. WRITE — prohibited.

tools.name: remove_option_from_watchlist
tools.description: Remove option contracts from the user's options watchlist. WRITE — prohibited.

tools.name: create_watchlist
tools.description: Create a new custom watchlist. WRITE — prohibited.

tools.name: update_watchlist
tools.description: Rename a custom watchlist or change its icon/description. WRITE — prohibited.

tools.name: follow_watchlist
tools.description: Follow a Robinhood-curated list. WRITE — prohibited.

tools.name: unfollow_watchlist
tools.description: Stop following a Robinhood-curated list. WRITE — prohibited.

tools.name: create_scan
tools.description: Create a new saved scanner on the user's account. WRITE (creates persistent account state) — prohibited.

tools.name: update_scan_config
tools.description: Change the sort order of a saved scan's results table. WRITE — prohibited.

tools.name: update_scan_filters
tools.description: Replace the filters on an existing saved scan. WRITE — prohibited.
